consequence: For a q=5 weight-625 apartment-code word, if the P/opposite-point chart type contains any heavy chart then A_P<=240, hence total active charts A<=490 because A_L<=250. The old P-side candidate (h8,h9)=(2,1), A_P=248 is impossible.
asymmetry_firewall: The canonical L/opposite-line chart-intersection graph is connected at q=3 and q=5, so this tensor decomposition does not automatically apply to L charts. A nonstar minimum word could in principle be P-heavy, L-heavy, or both; the L-heavy-only case remains open here.
improvement: Conditional on P-side heaviness, the active-chart deficit improves from 2 to at least 10 in the P type.
boundary: P-side theorem only. It does not eliminate an L-heavy-only exotic weight-625 word and therefore does not by itself give a universal A<=490 bound for every nonstar minimum word.
